title: rosa gallica var. agatha
intro: Rosa gallica var. agatha, commonly known as the French Rose or Officinal Rose, is a fragrant, pink-flowering shrub native to Europe. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Rosa gallica var. agatha are attributed to its calming, sedative, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to relax the nervous system and reduce muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, such as geraniol and linalool, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
